title: Fast Bayesian Optimization Through Linear Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29580v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is typically used only for problems where the underlying function is deemed "expensive" (e.g. in time or money), with the speed of the BO algorithm being of little importance. In the real world, however, problems span a continuous range of values, going from cheap to expensive. In this paper, we present BO algorithms through the lens of a speed-performance Pareto frontier: we compare BO against faster algorithms like CMA-ES, and highlight how certain regions of the Pareto frontier are currently empty. As a solution, we propose a new set of fast BO methods that exploit the linear structure in existing BO algorithms, for both continuous and combinatorial inputs (from ~10 to 6000+ dimensions). Our methods achieve performance similar to state-of-the-art BO, while being more than $10^2\times$ to $10^3\times$ faster, opening the field of BO to an entirely new class of problems.

translated_title: 基于线性模型的快速贝叶斯优化
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）通常仅用于那些底层函数被认为“昂贵”（例如在时间或金钱上）的问题，此时BO算法本身的运行速度并不重要。然而在现实世界中，问题的成本跨越一个从便宜到昂贵的连续范围。在本文中，我们通过速度-性能帕累托前沿的视角来审视贝叶斯优化：我们将BO与CMA-ES等更快的算法进行比较，并指出帕累托前沿的某些区域目前是空白的。作为解决方案，我们提出了一组新的快速BO方法，这些方法利用了现有BO算法中的线性结构，适用于连续输入和组合输入（维度从约10维到6000维以上）。我们的方法实现了与最先进BO相似的性能，同时速度快了10²倍到10³倍以上，为贝叶斯优化领域开辟了一类全新的问题。
tldr: 本文提出了利用现有贝叶斯优化算法线性结构的新型快速BO方法，在保持与最先进算法相当性能的同时将速度提升100至1000倍以上，从而将贝叶斯优化的适用范围拓展到成本敏感的全新问题类别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new set of fast Bayesian optimization methods that exploit the linear structure of existing BO algorithms, achieving state-of-the-art performance while being over 10²× to 10³× faster, opening the field of BO to an entirely new class of speed-sensitive problems.
